_comment_model: Model directory name (relative to models/) or absolute path. Set to empty string '' to force auto-detection.
_comment_backend_port: Port for the backend inference server (llama-server on Linux/Win, MLX on macOS). API gateway proxies to this.
_comment_ui_port: Port for the Lumina Core Vite dev server.
_comment_api_port_secondary: Secondary management-only port (no inference). Reserved for future use.
_comment_ctx_size: Context window size in tokens. Minimum 4096 enforced. Higher values allow longer conversations but increase RAM/VRAM usage. Auto-tuned by system_optimizer.py.
_comment_gpu: n_gpu_layers: number of layers to offload to GPU (99 = all layers, 0 = CPU-only). gpu_type: nvidia/intel/amd/apple_silicon. n_gpu_layers=0 is safest for constrained hardware (pure CPU inference).
_comment_threading: threads: CPU threads for generation. threads_batch: CPU threads for prompt processing.
_comment_sampling: Sampling parameters for llama.cpp (ignored on macOS — use mlx_sampling instead).
_comment_top_k: top_k sampling parameter (40 is consistent across all launchers; discrepancy with shell scripts has been resolved).
_comment_kv_quant: KV cache quantization type: q4_0, q8_0, f16, none. q4_0 (4-bit) default for constrained hardware. kv_cache_type_k/v take precedence over this.
_comment_kv_cache_type_k: llama.cpp K cache quantization type (q4_0, q8_0, f16). Default: q4_0 for 4-bit KV cache.
_comment_kv_cache_type_v: llama.cpp V cache quantization type (q4_0, q8_0, f16). Default: q4_0 for 4-bit KV cache.
_comment_numa: numa_mode: distribute (multi-socket) or none (single socket). Auto-detected by system_optimizer.py.
_comment_prompt_cache: Enable prompt caching. WARNING: defaults to 8GB limit which can cause OOM on constrained systems.
_comment_llama_cpp: MoE (Mixture of Experts) and memory-mapping flags — for llama.cpp only.
_comment_llama_cpp_dir: Path to llama.cpp directory (for model conversion). Used by model-converter.py.
_comment_mlx_a: KV cache size cap — prevents unbounded growth (null = unlimited/model default).
_comment_mlx_b: Sampling parameters exposed for UI control (macOS/MLX only).
_comment_mlx_c: Enable Metal performance optimizations (env vars set before mlx import).
_comment_mlx_d: Memory limit as fraction of RAM (null = don't set, 0.65 = 65% of unified memory).
_comment_mlx_cache: Cache directory for downloaded MLX models. Empty string = use default (code resolves ~ at runtime).
_comment_mlx_e1: Top-level MLX KV bits (4-bit by default). Exposed for quick access; overrides mlx_kv_quant_native.kv_bits if set.
_comment_mlx_e2: MLX KV group size (64 by default). Overrides mlx_kv_quant_native.kv_group_size if set.
_comment_mlx_e: Native KV quantization — mutually exclusive with asymmetric mlx_kv_quant.
_comment_mlx_f: Asymmetric KV quantization (K bits / V bits) — mutual exclusive with mlx_kv_quant_native.
_comment_reserved_startup: startup: Reserved for startup pipeline control.
